fields.v: None of code quality; Case B reports evidence-based question coverage of the scraper (Exp 7: 20/20 -> 14/20 audited -> 18/20 after fix; Exp 8: 20/20 -> 12/20 -> 18/20)
fields.quote: The original 20-of-20 coverage claims for two prior experiments were revised down to 14 and 12 evidence-based answers at T2, then up to 18 and 18 at T4 after the fix.
fields.where: §5.2.2 A retroactive audit, made possible by provenance, Table 1 and Figure 3, p. 10
fields.why: The notation "14/12 -> 18/18" reads as fractions (14 of 12) instead of the per-experiment counts out of 20 given in Table 1.
fields.doubt: O valor "20/20 -> 14/12 -> 18/18" mistura as duas experiências e parece uma fração (14 em 12). A Tabela 1 na pág. 10 dá Exp 7: 20/20, 14/20, 18/20 e Exp 8: 20/20, 12/20, 18/20. Confirma e reescreve como no campo Evaluation.
